notes.title: Halloween Update!
notes.content:
We welcome you to the Puppet Play Horror Picture Show! 
Much awaits you in this new addition to your own movie studio!

This update does add and change quite a lot of things! Lets get started with the new features!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/8Wj7PHMapZ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/67a0997e5a6a81e19742ba1d540f3b92c53aa13e.png[/img][/url]



[h2]Scaling![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/cc9d4bed7fc2f61a9ae080072451c84f1e5526ea.gif[/img]
You can now change and animate the size of mostly anything! Simply open the context menu and select "Show Scale" to activate it! You can switch between free & normal scaling by pressing the trigger!
[i]The humanoid mouth puppets as well as the beloved stuffed T-rex don't support scaling yet! These need a more complex rework to handle that! This will be added in an update soon![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/37e97a35ac1f228c569eaf1f2f2eb7e901fa4f01.png[/img]



[h2]Animate Fingers![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/dfefc0d22a2557494d74f129000d3afdee63b3d0.gif[/img]
Most humanoid figures (around 80%) now support finger animations in mocap mode! Also supports index controllers! 



[h2]New mouths for low poly characters![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/d1ec5d5afb328c1faf50aeb97d5d4449f59a219b.gif[/img]
Not a big addition, but I love how they look so I had to include them here!



[h2]Tutorial![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/5f94a47124eb70f985d1aebe31c1790b9d514fa3.png[/img]
Finally a tutorial! 


[h2] Additional Feature List[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]New default control scheme[/b] thats closer to conventional VR controller layouts. Also switched the sides of record and gallery button. 
[*] Gallery Changes: Moved player back to give a better overview of the shelves. improved distance grab
[*] [b]Lock Items[/b] in Context menu to prevent accidentally grabbing attached hats or hair
[*] [b]Smooth hand movement![/b] Can be adjusted in settings
[*] Improved depth of field controller with depth layer indicator. Its located in the lens of the camera.
[*] Greatly [b]improved light quality[/b]! Higher resolution and better contours
[*] New inverse kinematic system. That the thing that moved the arm, when you move the hand position. Arm position looks much more realistic now! Same for legs.
[*] New sprite for Timeline
[*] Environment light now gets darker when its set to night
[*] [i]Many new settings:[/i]
[*] Settings to change export framerate and size
[*] Settings to change camera on screen
[*] Setting to change hand smoothness
[*] All settings are now saved.
[/list]



[h1]New Assets:[/h1]


[h2]Backrooms Set[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/f7fb228954a2f53d6108d2c81b7f65c5588a1061.png[/img]


[h2]Horror Set[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/2bd3bb64780665bef25f60e3f03aa39c1432bacf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/dc1ed89cc38b262c4bcb4a30e9308f5e22d00f34.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/f7248432c7a1c275296f1c1e676bebd13d911db1.png[/img]


[h2]New Characters & Props[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/f2f95511fd2f2b429a417a01be642a1b8eff02a2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/5c4d599fc5cba8e170fe19a9205a054d3b9fdad7.png[/img]


Also:
[list]
[*] New food items
[*] new set of cardboard props

[/list]


Thats it!
Also in case you are in Hamburg, Germany next week: Puppet Play is being shown on the [url=https://playfestival.de/award.html]PLAY Creative Gaming Festival![/url]. It was nominated for the "Most Creative Game" - Award!

notes.title: Welcome Trash Ken!
notes.content:
[h2]Change your height & Size![/h2]
[list]
[*] Animate objects high in the air, over large distances, or just be closer to the action than ever before. You can now change your own height & size ingame! 
[*] Hold both trigger & grip buttons on one controller to adjust your height. Do the same with both controllers at the same time to change your scale. 
[*] You can go from 0.4 - 6x the regular scale
[*] If your scale goes above 4x, you are no longer able to grab really small to prevent any accidental grabs. Like  attached items & those small sticks, like the one used to control arms.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/08c452cfc07ecc00875db9f2108cae4f77464f30.gif[/img]

[h2]Become a Star-Photographer[/h2]
[list]
[*] Whether you need a thumbnail for your video or want to quickly save a fun moment, you can now make screenshots!
[*] These are taken from the camera's perspective
[*] They are stored in the game's directory, under: [i]Puppet Play Data >> Captured_Screenshots[/i]
[*] Share your images on our [url=https://discord.gg/8Wj7PHMapZ]Discord [/url]or in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1666890/images/]Artwork-Section of our Community Hub[/url]!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/84a2cc952ab5c49904633aaaa1997532954798c8.jpg[/img]

[h2]You can’t reach for anything new if your hands are still full of yesterday’s junk.[/h2]
[i]– Louise Smith[/i]
[list]
[*] This is [i]Trash Ken[/i], a new companion that will take care of any toys you don't want to play with anymore!
[*] Makes it easier to try out different things in the gallery!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/071f8c6ed625355301d8a7672812e268b8856c0b.gif[/img]


[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Unable to grab clips in audio-menu
[*] head up animation clips (below timeline) were offset
[*] didn't remove animation clips & lines on delete
[*] improved distance grab in gallery
[*] several small changes
[/list]

[h3]Sound offset bug[/h3]
Currently there is a bug in the game that recorded sounds are offset. This happens if the soundclip doesn't start from the beginning, but somewhere in the middle. For example when not starting the animation from the start. This is unfortunately a more complicated bug to fix as it is a limitation from the unity engine we are using. We are still working on finding a good solution!
[b]When replaying the animation from the start, everything is in sync. So don't worry about your exported videos![/b] For now I disabled the ability to move clips before the first frame in the audio menu, to make sure that, when replaying the animation form the beginning, everything is correct!


Any questions or suggestions?
[url=https://discord.gg/8Wj7PHMapZ]Join our discord![/url]

- Team Puppet Play!

[*] New Christmas Props & Items
[*] New locomotion method using one stick to move and one to rotate. Press in left jostick to edit timeline
[/list]

[list]
[*] No microphones shown in debug menu
[*] removed endless loading bug when starting game
[*] fixes issue with vive controllers
[*] fixed mouth puppet remotes not disappearing properly

[/list]


So this is the first and last update for Puppet Play for the rest of the year! We want to use this oppurtunity to thank everyone who has supported us so far! We had a great launch and can't wait to see what you'll think of all the things we have planned for the future!
